title: Define typed template inputs
description: Extend reusable label templates with versioned named typed input definitions, optional defaults, and explicit validation constraints that remain serializable and non-executable.
acceptanceCriteria: A template input definition stores stable name, supported type, optional default, explicit constraints, and schema version
Input names are unique within a template and invalid or reserved names return path-specific diagnostics
Defaults are validated by the same rules as assignment values
Unsupported types, executable formulas, and non-serializable constraints are rejected
Schema round trips preserve input order and normalized definitions

steps.details: Add the minimal supported typed-value union and versioned TemplateInputDefinition beside the existing template schema, including optional default and bounded constraints.
Validate unique names, supported types, constraint compatibility, and defaults with stable field-path diagnostics.
Normalize input definitions in a documented stable order without evaluating formulas, code, or implicit coercions.
Round-trip valid definitions and cover duplicate names, invalid defaults, mismatched constraints, unsupported types, and executable payload refusal.

technicalNotes: Keep this task under ten minutes by limiting the initial typed-value union to types explicitly needed by current component properties.
Data inputs are values only; formulas and arbitrary evaluation remain out of scope.
